Fixed the `Context.res` setter in `src/context.ts` to merge both cookie sets instead of discarding cookies from the new `Response`. It also de-duplicates exact cookie values so existing `c.body()`/`c.text()` flows don’t produce duplicate headers.

Added and updated regression coverage in `src/context.test.ts` for merging middleware cookies with handler response cookies.
